# Workflow Status Badges

Add these badges to your README.md to show the status of your workflows:

```markdown
[![Dev to Test Workflow](https://github.com/MasterOz786/MLOps-A/workflows/Dev%20to%20Test%20Workflow/badge.svg)](https://github.com/MasterOz786/MLOps-A/actions/workflows/dev-to-test-workflow.yml)

[![Unit Tests](https://github.com/MasterOz786/MLOps-A/workflows/Unit%20Tests/badge.svg)](https://github.com/MasterOz786/MLOps-A/actions/workflows/unit-tests.yml)

[![CI/CD Pipeline](https://github.com/MasterOz786/MLOps-A/workflows/CI/CD%20Pipeline/badge.svg)](https://github.com/MasterOz786/MLOps-A/actions/workflows/ci-cd-pipeline.yml)

[![Auto PR from Dev to Test](https://github.com/MasterOz786/MLOps-A/workflows/Auto%20PR%20from%20Dev%20to%20Test/badge.svg)](https://github.com/MasterOz786/MLOps-A/actions/workflows/auto-pr-dev-to-test.yml)
```

## How to Use

1. Copy the badge markdown code above
2. Paste it into your README.md file
3. The badges will automatically show the status of your workflows
4. Clicking on a badge will take you to the workflow runs

## Badge Colors

- 🟢 Green: All checks passed
- 🟡 Yellow: Workflow is running
- 🔴 Red: Some checks failed
- ⚪ Gray: No recent runs
